title: Co-founded Tencent in 1998 and served as Chief Administrative Officer
statement: Co-founded Tencent in 1998 and served as Chief Administrative Officer, later launching the Tencent Charity Foundation in 2007.

title: Stepped down as Tencent CAO in March 2013 to dedicate himself
statement: Stepped down as Tencent CAO in March 2013 to dedicate himself full-time to philanthropy, founding the Chen Yidan Charity Foundation and later the Yidan Prize (2016).
outcome: Chen established Wuhan College, the Chen Yidan Charity Foundation, and the HK$2.5 billion Yidan Prize, and was recognized as China's top philanthropist in national rankings, while retaining honorary ties to Tencent's charity arm.
